items.title: Vida Scene Search: AI Scene-Level Search With No Manual Logging Required
items.excerpt: Vida launched Scene Search, an offline AI-powered indexing tool inside Vida Content OS that lets editors and post teams search a video library at the scene level using natural language, with no manually logged metadata. A concrete craft shift for how film and TV post finds and reuses footage.

items.title: HP Z Captis + Adobe Substance 3D: Digital Twin Capture Built for Scale
items.excerpt: HP and Adobe updated the HP Z Captis capture system with faster speeds and deeper Adobe Substance 3D Sampler integration, running hybrid AI inference on NVIDIA Jetson AGX to build production-ready digital twins for VFX and virtual production. A look at how AI-accelerated asset capture feeds the film pipeline.

items.title: Why we chose it: Estonia's FrostFX on using AI as another creative tool in post
items.excerpt: Estonian VFX studio FrostFX details a post pipeline that treats AI not as a replacement for artists but as a tool that removes repetitive technical work so artists spend more time on creative decisions. A grounded studio-level view of how an AI-assisted VFX workflow actually shifts the craft.
